title: German Fish Bisque
description: A hearty and flavorful German-inspired fish soup made with halal fish and a rich bisque.
instructions: Heat the heavy cream in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the fish stock, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add the halal fish fillets to the saucepan and cook until they flake easily with a fork.
Stir in the dry white wine (if using), lemon juice, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Reduce the heat to low and let the bisque simmer for an additional 5-10 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the German Fish Bisque hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives (optional).
